title: 기술대학설립ㆍ운영규정시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00779:20010131:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 779, January 31, 2001>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (15) Omitted.
(16) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Technical Colleges shall be amended as follows:
In Articles 3, 4 (1), the former part of paragraph (2), Articles 5 and 6, Article 9 (1), and Article 12, "Minister of Education" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development."
(17) through (41) Omitted.
